poseScreen.method: V33 dynamic head-subtree meshes; active jaw/cap vs every other head-subtree rigid owner. Evaluated BVH strict edge-through-face crossings,1e-7 plane epsilon,1e-6 edge/barycentric margin. Tangencies/coplanar/contained and same-owner contacts excluded. Seven discrete poses, not continuous physics clearance.

sameOwnerInterMesh.scope: Distinct V33 swept cranial leaf pairs owned by cranial-cover and distinct swept temporal leaf pairs owned by head, at native rest. Cross-owner cranial/temporal pairs and intra-mesh self-intersections are excluded. Each mesh is evaluated and transformed to world space before BVH overlap and strict edge-through-face confirmation.
sameOwnerInterMesh.method: Reused frozen proper-crossing kernel: 1e-7 plane epsilon and 1e-6 barycentric/edge margin. BVH candidates are reported separately from strict crossings; coplanar/tangent/containment cases are not established. No intra-mesh self-intersection check.

intraMeshNonAdjacentTriangleScreen.method: Evaluated triangle self-overlap per V33 cranial/temporal leaf mesh at native rest. Candidate pairs are canonicalized to ia<ib and excluded if triangles share any vertex; remaining BVH candidates use frozen strict edge-through-face test (1e-7 plane epsilon, 1e-6 barycentric/edge margin). No containment or coplanar/tangent proof.

visualJudgment.comparison: V32 Form01 matched head views plus actual owner whole-bird reference; July image remains scoped head-only/open-jaw reference.
visualJudgment.finding: Form05 is directionally improved at rest: cap-to-temporal strict inter-owner pairs are absent in the seven tested states, and distinct temporal leaf intersections are gone. Same-owner cranial inter-leaf intersections are reduced to two pairs. The cap still reads as thin swept strips with exposed gaps in the neutral side view; the optic facade remains broad and mask-like. This is a bounded fit/render observation, not likeness acceptance.

limitations: Seven discrete native poses only; not continuous swept-volume, containment, coplanar/tangent or physical-guide proof.
The self-triangle screen excludes triangle pairs sharing vertices and applies strict edge-through-face confirmation; candidate overlaps alone are not treated as crossings.
No source geometry was edited; this folder contains scripts, logs, rendered views and receipts only.

form01SelfScreenBaseline.method: Evaluated triangle self-overlap per V33 cranial/temporal leaf mesh at native rest. Candidate pairs are canonicalized to ia<ib and excluded if triangles share any vertex; remaining BVH candidates use frozen strict edge-through-face test (1e-7 plane epsilon, 1e-6 barycentric/edge margin). No containment or coplanar/tangent proof.

comparisonNote: Non-adjacent self-triangle strict crossings cluster near u=1 free tips in both Form01 and Form05. Form05 rises from 604 strict triangle pairs on 25/43 leaf meshes to 1789 on 43/43; Form05 adds outer-face involvement. Triangle-role mapping is derived from the frozen nu=30,nv=14 face construction and retained as per-witness roles.
